definitions.independent_unit: paired run; claims are not independent experimental replicates
definitions.latency: nearest-rank quantiles of exported Go duration fields for all claims through final Ready, including drain
definitions.ready_minus_ack: per-request sandboxReadyMs - createAckMs; median_ms averages the middle two for even n; p50_ms uses nearest rank; signed watch/API timing
definitions.paired_difference_ms: Ready-minus-Ack endpoints use candidate minus baseline (noise: slot 2 minus slot 1); ratios and percent changes are null for denominators <= 0
definitions.host_window: observed traffic trigger..arrivals_finished UTC, not first claim plus nominal duration
definitions.host_validity: memory, paging and CPU readings remain visible independently of lifecycle validation; interpret latency alongside controller/API and host load
definitions.controller_window: start/end telemetry counter difference; monotonic scrape midpoint duration
definitions.inventory: sampled Ready inventory extrema, not continuous-time extrema
definitions.initial_inventory: Expected start Ready=128; start Ready plus startup warm/ready adoptions can support compatibility with prewarm, without proving pre-arrival state. Deviations remain protocol observations and do not exclude runs or pairs.
definitions.inventory_exhaustion: true when any telemetry sample has Ready inventory zero; not_observed leaves between-sample exhaustion unresolved
definitions.cold_starts: cold/not_ready final counter, reported separately from sampled inventory exhaustion
definitions.scenario_inclusion: Cold launches, unready pool adoptions and inventory exhaustion are observations, not exclusion criteria; retain complete runs in the registered primary comparison
definitions.launch_conditions: Sandbox Ready state at adoption completion; namespace/pool-scoped final counters
definitions.statistics: long8 p50 only is inferential; all other endpoints and groups are descriptive
definitions.negative_controls: same-binary slot 2 / slot 1, separate from baseline/candidate comparisons
definitions.effect_sign: negative percent change means lower candidate value (noise: lower second value)
